title: Birational Classification of Orbifold Compactified Jacobians
summary: We study the equivariant orbifold birational classification problem for families of toroidal compactifications of a group $G$ over a toroidal base, in the cases where $G$ is an algebraic torus or a semiabelian scheme. The classification is reduced to the problem of finding the minimal orbifold toroidal compactifications of $G$ in the world of logarithmic geometry, which is shown to be a combinatorial problem.
